cells.gaps: No row establishes the text of the Livro Branco das TIC 2023-2027 as public: the only text row (AGO-013) is the 2019-2022 White Paper's despacho, the instrument it repealed. Nothing is held on a mandated body, finance, a delivery plan or reporting against the policy, and no dated event falls in the twelve months to the as-at beyond a presidential mention (AGO-015).
cells.note: Livro Branco das TIC 2023-2027: adopted by Presidential Decree 272/24 of 5 December 2024 with its period running to 2027, replacing the 2019-2022 White Paper. Stage 3 needs the text public, and no source holds, links or quotes it from an official site, so an adopted policy whose text nobody has found stops at stage 2, unflagged.
